title: 1inch swapp
tagline: Stop-loss tool on 1inch for automated token sell orders via Limit Order Protocol.
description: 1inch swapp is a stop-Loss Manager is a portfolio risk management app built on the 1inch Protocol. It not only fetches real-time token balances across multiple wallets and chains, but also allows users to set automated stop-loss orders using the 1inch Limit Order Protocol. Designed for multi-token portfolios, the app abstracts complex DeFi operations into a simple, user-friendly interface, enabling automated downside protection, gas-efficient order execution, and trustless, on-chain order fulfillment. With monitoring and execution fully integrated, traders can protect their assets without constantly watching the market, making DeFi trading safer, smarter, and more accessible.
how_its_made: The 1inch swapp stop-Loss Manager leverages the 1inch Aggregation API to fetch real-time token balances across multiple wallets and DEXes, giving users a complete view of their portfolio. Automated stop-loss orders are powered by the 1inch Limit Order Protocol, executing trades on-chain when user-defined price thresholds are met. Wallet integration via WalletConnect ensures secure, non-custodial access to funds, while the Next.js frontend with Tailwind CSS provides a fast, responsive, and intuitive interface. Optional backend services built with Node.js and Express handle order monitoring, validation, and cross-chain logic. All stop-loss executions are fully trustless and on-chain, allowing users to automate risk management while maintaining complete control over their assets.
